verses.sloka: निर्वृत्ते तु क्रतौ तस्मिन् हयमेधे महात्मनः ।प्रति गृह्य अमरा भागान् प्रतिजग्मुः यथा आगतम् ॥१-१८-१॥
verses.transliteration: nirvṛtte tu kratau tasmin hayamedhe mahātmanaḥ ।prati gṛhya amarā bhāgān pratijagmuḥ yathā āgatam ॥1-18-1॥

translations.english: Completed by the magnanimous king (Dasaratha). The aswamedha and putreshti sacrifices, the devatas received their share of havis and returned to their respective abodes.
translations.hindi: र (0 सप्तदशः सर्ग; पुत्रत्वं तु गते विष्णौ राज्ञस्तस्य महात्मनः । उवाच देवताः सर्वाः स्वयंभूर्भगवानिदम्‌

verses.sloka: समाप्त दीक्षा नियमः पत्नी गण समन्वितः ।प्रविवेश पुरीम् राजा स भृत्य बल वाहनः ॥१-१८-२॥
verses.transliteration: samāpta dīkṣā niyamaḥ patnī gaṇa samanvitaḥ ।praviveśa purīm rājā sa bhṛtya bala vāhanaḥ ॥1-18-2॥

translations.english: Having completed the prescribed vows (in respect of aswamedha), king Dasaratha together with his queens returned to the city of Ayodhya accompanied by his attendants, army and chariots.
translations.hindi: सत्यसन्ध, वीर, और सब का हित चाहने वाले भगवान्‌ विष्णु की सहायता. के लिए तुम लोग भी बलवान, - कामरूपी SEASONS SE क ्र ————i— ` क्रगोविन्द्राजीय संस्करण में ये दो पद त्रम्राप्तं हैं। . ? > ६» ( जैसा चाहे वैसा रूप बनाने वाले ) माया को जानने वाले, वेग में पवन तुल्य, नीतिज्ञ, बुद्धिमान्‌, पराक्रम में विष्णु के ही समान, जिनको कोई मार न सके, उद्यमी, दिव्य शरीर वाले, अख-- बिद्या में निपुण और देवताओं के सदृशा वानरों को; अप्सराओं,. गन्धर्वो की ख्मिश्रों और यक्षों एबं नागों की कन्याओं, ऋत्तियों, विद्याधरियों, किन्नरियों और वानरियों से उत्पन्न करो

verses.sloka: यथा अर्हम् पूजिताः तेन राज्ञा च पृथिवीश्वराः ।मुदिताः प्रययुः देशान् प्रणम्य मुनि पुंगवम् ॥१-१८-३॥
verses.transliteration: yathā arham pūjitāḥ tena rājñā ca pṛthivīśvarāḥ ।muditāḥ prayayuḥ deśān praṇamya muni puṁgavam ॥1-18-3॥

translations.english: Having been honoured by the king (Dasaratha) in a be fitting manner, the highly pleased lords of the earth (kings) made obeisance to the best of sages (Vasishta) and returned to their own countries.

verses.sloka: श्रीमताम् गच्छताम् तेषाम् स्वगृहाणि पुरात् ततः ।बलानि राज्ञाम् शुभ्राणि प्रहृष्टानि चकाशिरे ॥१-१८-४॥
verses.transliteration: śrīmatām gacchatām teṣām svagṛhāṇi purāt tataḥ ।balāni rājñām śubhrāṇi prahṛṣṭāni cakāśire ॥1-18-4॥

translations.english: When the army of the kings left the city (Ayodhya) for their own, the armed forces shone bright and cheerfl.

verses.sloka: गतेषु पृथिवीशेषु राजा दशरथः पुनः ।प्रविवेश पुरीम् श्रीमान् पुरस्कृत्य द्विजोत्तमान् ॥१-१८-५॥
verses.transliteration: gateṣu pṛthivīśeṣu rājā daśarathaḥ punaḥ ।praviveśa purīm śrīmān puraskṛtya dvijottamān ॥1-18-5॥

translations.english: After the departure of the rulers, the exalted king Dasaratha preceded by the foremost of brahmins entered the city (of Ayodhya).
translations.hindi: ऋषयश्च महात्मानः सिद्धविद्याधरो एगा! चारणाश्च सतान्वीरान्ससृज॒वनचारिणः ॥&॥ ब्रह्मा जी 'की इस आज्ञा के अनुसार, ऋत्षों, सिद्धों, चारणों,- विद्याधरों और नागों ने वानर रूपी पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया

verses.sloka: शांतया प्रययौ सार्धम् ऋष्यशृङ्गः सुपूजितः ।अनुगम्यमानो राज्ञा च सानुयात्रेण धीमता ॥१-१८-६॥
verses.transliteration: śāṁtayā prayayau sārdham ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ supūjitaḥ ।anugamyamāno rājñā ca sānuyātreṇa dhīmatā ॥1-18-6॥

translations.english: Having been duly honoured by king Dasaratha, sage Rsyasringa with his wife Santa accompanied by the wise king Romapada and his followers set out for his country.

verses.sloka: एवम् विसृज्य तान् सर्वान् राजा संपूर्ण मानसः ।उवास सुखितः तत्र पुत्र उत्पत्तिम् विचिंतयन् ॥१-१८-७॥
verses.transliteration: evam visṛjya tān sarvān rājā saṁpūrṇa mānasaḥ ।uvāsa sukhitaḥ tatra putra utpattim viciṁtayan ॥1-18-7॥

translations.english: When they (guests) all departed in this manner, Dasaratha with his desire fulfilled, his thought centred on begetting sons lived happily.
translations.hindi: मैंने भी पहले भालुओं में श्रेष्ठ जाम्बवान्‌ नामक रीछ को पैदा किया था । वह जमुहाई लेते समय मेरे मुख से सहसा निकल पड़ा था

verses.sloka: ततो यज्ञे समाप्ते तु ऋतूनाम् षट् समत्ययुः ।ततः च द्वादशे मासे चैत्रे नावमिके तिथौ ॥१-१८-८॥
verses.transliteration: tato yajñe samāpte tu ṛtūnām ṣaṭ samatyayuḥ ।tataḥ ca dvādaśe māse caitre nāvamike tithau ॥1-18-8॥

translations.english: Six seasons (one year) passed after the completion of the sacrifice. In the twelfth month of Chaitra on the ninth day (of the bright fortnight), with Aditi as presiding deity when the star Punarvasu was in the ascendent and the five planets Sun, Mars, Saturn, Jupiter and Venus, were exalted in their own house in karkata lagna, when Brihaspati was in conjunction with the Moon, Kausalya gave birth to a son: a facet of Visnu, Lord of the entire universe who received obeisance from all the worlds and was adorned with all auspicious signs, the venerable one to perpetuate the Ikshvaku race.

verses.sloka: नक्क्षत्रे अदिति दैवत्ये स्व उच्छ संस्थेषु पंचसु ।ग्रहेषु कर्कटे लग्ने वाक्पता इंदुना सह ॥१-१८-९॥
verses.transliteration: nakkṣatre aditi daivatye sva uccha saṁstheṣu paṁcasu ।graheṣu karkaṭe lagne vākpatā iṁdunā saha ॥1-18-9॥

translations.english: Six seasons (one year) passed after the completion of the sacrifice. In the twelfth month of Chaitra on the ninth day (of the bright fortnight), with Aditi as presiding deity when the star Punarvasu was in the ascendent and the five planets Sun, Mars, Saturn, Jupiter and Venus, were exalted in their own house in karkata lagna, when Brihaspati was in conjunction with the Moon, Kausalya gave birth to a son: a facet of Visnu, Lord of the entire universe who received obeisance from all the worlds and was adorned with all auspicious signs, the venerable one to perpetuate the Ikshvaku race.

verses.sloka: प्रोद्यमाने जगन्नाथम् सर्व लोक नमस्कृतम् ।कौसल्या अजनयत् रामम् सर्व लक्षण संयुतम् ॥१-१८-१०॥
verses.transliteration: prodyamāne jagannātham sarva loka namaskṛtam ।kausalyā ajanayat rāmam sarva lakṣaṇa saṁyutam ॥1-18-10॥

translations.english: Six seasons (one year) passed after the completion of the sacrifice. In the twelfth month of Chaitra on the ninth day (of the bright fortnight), with Aditi as presiding deity when the star Punarvasu was in the ascendent and the five planets Sun, Mars, Saturn, Jupiter and Venus, were exalted in their own house in karkata lagna, when Brihaspati was in conjunction with the Moon, Kausalya gave birth to a son: a facet of Visnu, Lord of the entire universe who received obeisance from all the worlds and was adorned with all auspicious signs, the venerable one to perpetuate the Ikshvaku race.
translations.hindi: नोट--कुछ लोग हनुमान जी को शिव जी के अंश से उत्पन्न हुआ समभते हैं | किन्तु उनके कथन का खण्डन १६वें श्लोक से हो जाता है । हनुमान जी पवन-तनय थे । ] इन्द्र ने महेन्द्राचल की तरह बालि, सूर्य ने सुग्रीव, बृहस्पति ने - तार, जो सब वानरों में मुख्य और अति चतुर था, कुबेर ने गन्ध-मादन, विश्वकर्मा ने नल, अग्नि ने नील, जो अग्नि के समान “ही तेजस्वी था तथा यश और पराक्रम में अपने पिता से भी बढ़ कर था; अश्विनी-कुमारों ने मैन्द और द्विविद, वरुण ने -सुषेण, वर्षा के अधिष्ठाता देवता ने शरभ और पवन ने हनुमान -नामक वानर उत्पन्न किया | इनकी. देह वज्र के समान द्रृढ थी अर यह वेग में गरुड़ के समान थे

verses.sloka: विष्णोः अर्धम् महाभागम् पुत्रम् ऐक्ष्वाकु नंदनम् ।लोहिताक्षम् महाबाहुम् रक्त ओष्टम् दुंदुभि स्वनम् ॥१-१८-११॥
verses.transliteration: viṣṇoḥ ardham mahābhāgam putram aikṣvāku naṁdanam ।lohitākṣam mahābāhum rakta oṣṭam duṁdubhi svanam ॥1-18-11॥

translations.english: Kausalya glowed with the undiminished lustre of her son, just as Aditi with her son Indra, the foremost among the gods and the wielder of thunder.

verses.sloka: कौसल्या शुशुभे तेन पुत्रेण अमित तेजसा ।यथा वरेण देवानाम् अदितिः वज्र पाणिना ॥१-१८-१२॥
verses.transliteration: kausalyā śuśubhe tena putreṇa amita tejasā ।yathā vareṇa devānām aditiḥ vajra pāṇinā ॥1-18-12॥

translations.english: As an incarnation of the fourth part of Visnu, imbued with all virtues, and armed with truth Bharata was born to Kaikeyi.

verses.sloka: भरतो नाम कैकेय्याम् जज्ञे सत्य पराक्रमः ।साक्षात् विष्णोः चतुर्थ भागः सर्वैः समुदितो गुणैः ॥१-१८-१३॥
verses.transliteration: bharato nāma kaikeyyām jajñe satya parākramaḥ ।sākṣāt viṣṇoḥ caturtha bhāgaḥ sarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ ॥1-18-13॥

translations.english: Sumitra gave birth to Lakshmana and Satrughna who were heroic, skilled in the use of all weapons and endowed with the facets of Visnu.

verses.sloka: अथ लक्ष्मण शत्रुघ्नौ सुमित्रा अजनयत् सुतौ ।वीरौ सर्व अस्त्र कुशलौ विष्णोः अर्ध समन्वितौ ॥१-१८-१४॥
verses.transliteration: atha lakṣmaṇa śatrughnau sumitrā ajanayat sutau ।vīrau sarva astra kuśalau viṣṇoḥ ardha samanvitau ॥1-18-14॥

translations.english: Bharata endowed with pure intellect was born in meena lagna when pushya was in the ascendant. Lakshmana and Satrughna were born in karkata lagna with the star aslesha .

verses.sloka: पुष्ये जातः तु भरतो मीन लग्ने प्रसन्न धीः ।सार्पे जातौ तु सौमित्री कुLईरे अभ्युदिते रवौ ॥१-१८-१५॥
verses.transliteration: puṣye jātaḥ tu bharato mīna lagne prasanna dhīḥ ।sārpe jātau tu saumitrī kuLīre abhyudite ravau ॥1-18-15॥

translations.english: Four worthy sons were successively born to the noble king (Dasaratha), endowed with all virtuous, resembling purvabhadra and uttarabhadra stars in brightness.

verses.sloka: राज्ञः पुत्रा महात्मानः चत्वारो जज्ञिरे पृथक् ।गुणवंतः अनुरूपाः च रुच्या प्रोष्ठ पदोपमाः ॥१-१८-१६॥
verses.transliteration: rājñaḥ putrā mahātmānaḥ catvāro jajñire pṛthak ।guṇavaṁtaḥ anurūpāḥ ca rucyā proṣṭha padopamāḥ ॥1-18-16॥

translations.english: The gandharvas sang melodiously. Groups of apsaras danced. Celestial kettledrums were sounded. Flowers were showered from the sky. Men througed to Ayodhya to witness the festivities.
translations.hindi: रीछ, बंदर, लंगूर सब ऐसे ही थे। जिस देवता का जैसा रूप, वेष व पराक्रम था, उनके अलग-अलग वैसे-बेसे ही पुत्र भी हुए बल्कि इन योनियों में विशेष पराक्रमी हुए

verses.sloka: जगुः कलम् च गंधर्वा ननृतुः च अप्सरो गणाः ।देव दुंदुभयो नेदुः पुष्प वृष्टिः च खात् पतत् ॥१-१८-१७॥
verses.transliteration: jaguḥ kalam ca gaṁdharvā nanṛtuḥ ca apsaro gaṇāḥ ।deva duṁdubhayo neduḥ puṣpa vṛṣṭiḥ ca khāt patat ॥1-18-17॥

translations.english: The gandharvas sang melodiously. Groups of apsaras danced. Celestial kettledrums were sounded. Flowers were showered from the sky. Men througed to Ayodhya to witness the festivities.
translations.hindi: पर्जन्यो = वर्षामिमानि देवता । (गो ककः NN, हा |; हनुमान जी बुद्धि और पराक्रम में अन्य सब वानरों से बढ़ चढ़ कर थे । इनके अतिरिक्त हजारों और भी बंदर, रावण के वध के लिए उत्पन्न किए गए

verses.sloka: उत्सवः च महान् आसीत् अयोध्यायाम् जनाकुलः ।रथ्याः च जन संबाधा नट नर्तक संकुलाः ॥१-१८-१८॥
verses.transliteration: utsavaḥ ca mahān āsīt ayodhyāyām janākulaḥ ।rathyāḥ ca jana saṁbādhā naṭa nartaka saṁkulāḥ ॥1-18-18॥

translations.english: The highways were crowded with men, thronged by actors and dancers. The voices of singers, performers on different instruments, eulogists and genealogists reverberated.
translations.hindi: जितने वानर उत्पन्न हुए वे सब के सब अत्यन्त बलवान छाचारी, गज और भूधराकार शारीर वाले हुए

verses.sloka: गायनैः च विराविण्यो वादनैः च तथ अपरैः ।विरेजुर् विपुलाः तत्र सर्व रत्न समन्विताः ॥१-१८-१९॥
verses.transliteration: gāyanaiḥ ca virāviṇyo vādanaiḥ ca tatha aparaiḥ ।virejur vipulāḥ tatra sarva ratna samanvitāḥ ॥1-18-19॥

translations.english: The king distributed deserving gifts to priests, euologists and genealogists. He gave brahmins in charity thousands of cows and other valuables.

verses.sloka: प्रदेयांश्च ददौ राजा सूत मागध वंदिनाम् ।ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ वित्तम् गो धनानि सहस्रशः ॥१-१८-२०॥
verses.transliteration: pradeyāṁśca dadau rājā sūta māgadha vaṁdinām ।brāhmaṇebhyo dadau vittam go dhanāni sahasraśaḥ ॥1-18-20॥

translations.english: After a lapse of eleven days, the naming ceremony was performed. Highly delighted preceptor Vasishta named Kausalya's son Rama, Kaikeyi's son Bharata, one son of Sumitra, Lakshmana and the other Satrughna.

verses.sloka: अतीत्य एकादश आहम् तु नाम कर्म तथा अकरोत् ।ज्येष्ठम् रामम् महात्मानम् भरतम् कैकयी सुतम् ॥१-१८-२१॥
verses.transliteration: atītya ekādaśa āham tu nāma karma tathā akarot ।jyeṣṭham rāmam mahātmānam bharatam kaikayī sutam ॥1-18-21॥

translations.english: After a lapse of eleven days, the naming ceremony was performed. Highly delighted preceptor Vasishta named Kausalya's son Rama, Kaikeyi's son Bharata, one son of Sumitra, Lakshmana and the other Satrughna.
translations.hindi: ॥ ऋत्षीष च तथा जाता वानराः -किन्तरीष॒ च । देवा मह्षिगन्धर्वास्ताक्ष्या यक्षा यशस्विनः

verses.sloka: सौमित्रिम् लक्ष्मणम् इति शत्रुघ्नम् अपरम् तथा ।वसिष्ठः परम प्रीतो नामानि कुरुते तदा ॥१-१८-२२॥
verses.transliteration: saumitrim lakṣmaṇam iti śatrughnam aparam tathā ।vasiṣṭhaḥ parama prīto nāmāni kurute tadā ॥1-18-22॥

translations.english: Brahmins as well as inhabitants of the city and rural areas were feasted. (Dasaratha) bestowed on brahmins unlimited and abundant jewels in charity. The rites at the time of birth and all other rites (associated with the newborn) were duly performed.

verses.sloka: ब्राह्मणान् भोजयामास पौरान् जानपदान् अपि ।उददद् ब्राह्मणानाम् च रत्नौघम् अमलम् बहु ॥१-१८-२३॥
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa paurān jānapadān api ।udadad brāhmaṇānām ca ratnaugham amalam bahu ॥1-18-23॥

translations.english: Among them, Rama like the exalted flag, became dear to his father like Brahma he was highly respected by all living beings.
translations.hindi: है ये सब वानर बड़े भारी डोल डोल के थे ओर दर्पं तथा बल में सिंह और शादूल के समान थे

verses.sloka: तेषाम् जन्म क्रिय आदीनि सर्व कर्माणि अकारयत् ।तेषाम् केतुः इव ज्येष्ठो रामो रतिकरः पितुः ॥१-१८-२४॥
verses.transliteration: teṣām janma kriya ādīni sarva karmāṇi akārayat ।teṣām ketuḥ iva jyeṣṭho rāmo ratikaraḥ pituḥ ॥1-18-24॥

translations.english: All the sons (of Dasaratha) became wellversed in the Vedas. They were heroic, endowed with knowledge and virtues and were devoted to the welfare of the people.
translations.hindi: है के सब शिलाओं, ब्रक्षो के प्रहार से युद्ध करने वाले, नखों और दाँतों के आयुधों वाले तथा सब अस्थो के चलाने में पण्डित थे

verses.sloka: बभूव भूयो भूतानाम् स्वयम् भूः इव सम्मतः ।सर्वे वेद विदः शूराः सर्वे लोकहिते रताः ॥१-१८-२५॥
verses.transliteration: babhūva bhūyo bhūtānām svayam bhūḥ iva sammataḥ ।sarve veda vidaḥ śūrāḥ sarve lokahite ratāḥ ॥1-18-25॥

translations.english: Among them the highly lustrous and truly mighty Rama was stainless (in character). He was auspicious to the entire world like the Moon.
translations.hindi: ये लोग बड़े-बड़े पर्वेतों को हिला देने वाले, बड़े बड़े जमे हुए पेड़ों को उखाड़ देने वाले और अपने बेग से समुद्र को भी छुब्ध करने वाले थे

verses.sloka: सर्वे ज्ञानोपसंपन्नाः सर्वे समुदिता गुणैः ।तेषाम् अपि महातेजा रामः सत्य पराक्रमः ॥१-१८-२६॥
verses.transliteration: sarve jñānopasaṁpannāḥ sarve samuditā guṇaiḥ ।teṣām api mahātejā rāmaḥ satya parākramaḥ ॥1-18-26॥

translations.english: Accepted as skilled in mounting elephants, riding horses, driving chariots and also in archery, he was always emgaged in the service of his parents.
translations.hindi: ये अपने पैर के प्रहार से प्रथ्वी को फोड़ने वाले, समुद्र के : पार जाने वाले, आकाश में उड्ने वाले और बादलों को भी पकड़ने वाले थे

verses.sloka: इष्टः सर्वस्य लोकस्य शशांक इव निर्मलः ।गज स्कन्धे अश्व पृष्टे च रथ चर्यासु सम्मतः ॥१-१८-२७॥
verses.transliteration: iṣṭaḥ sarvasya lokasya śaśāṁka iva nirmalaḥ ।gaja skandhe aśva pṛṣṭe ca ratha caryāsu sammataḥ ॥1-18-27॥

translations.english: Right from his very childhood Lakshmana, an enhancer of fortune, always remained very attached to his eldest brother Rama, the delight of the world.
translations.hindi: ये बानर, जंगलों में घूमने वाले और मदमस्त हाथियों को पकड़ने वाले, और किलकारी मार कर, आकाश में उडते हुए. पत्तियों को गिराने की सामर्थ रखने वाले थे

verses.sloka: धनुर्वेदे च निरतः पितुः शुशॄषणे रतः ।बाल्यात् प्रभृति सुस्निग्धो लक्ष्मणो लक्ष्मि वर्धनः ॥१-१८-२८॥
verses.transliteration: dhanurvede ca nirataḥ pituḥ śuśṝṣaṇe rataḥ ।bālyāt prabhṛti susnigdho lakṣmaṇo lakṣmi vardhanaḥ ॥1-18-28॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, possessed of fortune, was the dearest to his brother than his own body. As though he was his life without.

verses.sloka: रामस्य लोकरामस्य भ्रातुः ज्येष्ठस्य नित्यशः ।सर्व प्रिय करः तस्य रामस्य अपि शरीरतः ॥१-१८-२९॥
verses.transliteration: rāmasya lokarāmasya bhrātuḥ jyeṣṭhasya nityaśaḥ ।sarva priya karaḥ tasya rāmasya api śarīrataḥ ॥1-18-29॥

translations.english: Rama, the greatest among men would not sleep without Lakshmana's company. He would not partake even the choicest food minus to him.

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणो लक्ष्मि संपन्नो बहिः प्राण इव अपरः ।न च तेन विना निद्राम् लभते पुरुषोत्तमः ॥१-१८-३०॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇo lakṣmi saṁpanno bahiḥ prāṇa iva aparaḥ ।na ca tena vinā nidrām labhate puruṣottamaḥ ॥1-18-30॥

translations.english: Whenever Raghava (Rama) went hunting into the forest, riding the horse, Lakshmana used to follow him holding bow and arrows (in his hand).

verses.sloka: मृष्टम् अन्नम् उपानीतम् अश्नाति न हि तम् विना ।यदा हि हयम् आरूढो मृगयाम् याति राघवः ॥१-१८-३१॥
verses.transliteration: mṛṣṭam annam upānītam aśnāti na hi tam vinā ।yadā hi hayam ārūḍho mṛgayām yāti rāghavaḥ ॥1-18-31॥

translations.english: In a similar manner Satrughna, younger brother of Lakshmana, became dearer than his own life to Bharata. Similarly, Bharata also was dear to Satrughna.

verses.sloka: अथ एनम् पृष्ठतः अभ्येति स धनुः परिपालयन् ।भरतस्य अपि शत्रुघ्नो लक्ष्मण अवरजो हि सः ॥१-१८-३२॥
verses.transliteration: atha enam pṛṣṭhataḥ abhyeti sa dhanuḥ paripālayan ।bharatasya api śatrughno lakṣmaṇa avarajo hi saḥ ॥1-18-32॥

translations.english: With his very fortunate sons, Dasaratha was highly pleased like Brahma was with the gods.
translations.hindi: आर वहतों ने नल, नील, हनुमान तथा अन्य यूथपतियों -का सहारा लिया | वे सब गरुड़ के समान बलवान्‌ ओर युद्ध में कुशल थे

verses.sloka: प्राणैः प्रियतरो नित्यम् तस्य च आसीत् तथा प्रियः ।स चतुर्भिः महाभागैः पुत्रैः दशरथः प्रियैः ॥१-१८-३३॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇaiḥ priyataro nityam tasya ca āsīt tathā priyaḥ ।sa caturbhiḥ mahābhāgaiḥ putraiḥ daśarathaḥ priyaiḥ ॥1-18-33॥

translations.english: All his sons were enriched with knowledge and endowed with all virtues. They were modest, renowned, omniscient and farsighted. Dasaratha rejoiced at the sight of those glorious sons with such faculties and looked like Brahma, Lord of the worlds.
translations.hindi: बै सब वानर घूमते हुए सिंह, व्याघ्र और साँपों को भी मर्दन करने लगे । महाबली ओर महाबाहु बाली अपने विपुल विक्रम ओर अपनी भुजाओं के बल से बन्द्रों, रीछों और लंगूरों का पालन करने लगा । उन शूरवीर कपियों से, जिनके विविध प्रकार के रूप-रंग थे, पर्वत, बन, समद्र अं परिपूर्ण › चेन, समुद्र और प्रथ्वी के अनेक हो गये

verses.sloka: बभूव परम प्रीतो देवैः इव पितामहः ।ते यदा ज्ञान संपन्नाः सर्वैः समुदिता गुणैः ॥१-१८-३४॥
verses.transliteration: babhūva parama prīto devaiḥ iva pitāmahaḥ ।te yadā jñāna saṁpannāḥ sarvaiḥ samuditā guṇaiḥ ॥1-18-34॥

translations.english: All his sons were enriched with knowledge and endowed with all virtues. They were modest, renowned, omniscient and farsighted. Dasaratha rejoiced at the sight of those glorious sons with such faculties and looked like Brahma, Lord of the worlds.

verses.sloka: ह्रीमन्तः कीर्तिमन्तः च सर्वज्ञा दीर्घ दर्शिनः ।तेषाम् एवम् प्रभावाणाम् सर्वेषाम् दीप्त तेजसाम् ॥१-१८-३५॥
verses.transliteration: hrīmantaḥ kīrtimantaḥ ca sarvajñā dīrgha darśinaḥ ।teṣām evam prabhāvāṇām sarveṣām dīpta tejasām ॥1-18-35॥

translations.english: They (like) tigers among men, were fond of the study of the Vedas and were always engaged in the service of their parents. They were also proficient in the science of archery.

verses.sloka: पिता दशरथो हृष्टो ब्रह्मा लोकाधिपो यथा ।ते च अपि मनुज व्याघ्रा वैदिक अध्ययने रताः ॥१-१८-३६॥
verses.transliteration: pitā daśaratho hṛṣṭo brahmā lokādhipo yathā ।te ca api manuja vyāghrā vaidika adhyayane ratāḥ ॥1-18-36॥

translations.english: Then the virtuous king Dasaratha deliberated with his priests and kinsmen about the marriage of his sons.

verses.sloka: पितृ शुश्रूषण रता धनुर् वेदे च निष्टिताः ।अथ राजा दशरथः तेषाम् दार क्रियाम् प्रति ॥१-१८-३७॥
verses.transliteration: pitṛ śuśrūṣaṇa ratā dhanur vede ca niṣṭitāḥ ।atha rājā daśarathaḥ teṣām dāra kriyām prati ॥1-18-37॥

translations.english: While the nobleminded king was thus deliberating in the midst of his counsellors, there arrived the effulgent ascetic Viswamitra.

verses.sloka: चिंतयामास धर्मात्मा सह उपाध्यायः स बान्धवः ।तस्य चिंतयमानस्य मंत्रि मध्ये महात्मनः ॥१-१८-३८॥
verses.transliteration: ciṁtayāmāsa dharmātmā saha upādhyāyaḥ sa bāndhavaḥ ।tasya ciṁtayamānasya maṁtri madhye mahātmanaḥ ॥1-18-38॥

translations.english: Desirous of seeing the king (Dasaratha) he accosted the doorkeepers, saying "Inform the king quickly about the arrival of Viswamitra, the son of Gadhi born in the line of Kusika".

verses.sloka: अभ्यागच्छत् महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ।स राज्ञो दर्शन आकांक्षी द्वार अध्यक्षान् उवाच ह ॥१-१८-३९॥
verses.transliteration: abhyāgacchat mahātejā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ।sa rājño darśana ākāṁkṣī dvāra adhyakṣān uvāca ha ॥1-18-39॥

translations.english: On hearing those words (of Viswamitra) all of them prompted by fear because of left for the royal apartment with excited minds and hurried steps.

verses.sloka: शीघ्रम् आख्यात माम् प्राप्तम् कौशिकम् गाधिनः सुतम् ।तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य राज्ञो वेश्म प्रदुद्रुवुः ॥१-१८-४०॥
verses.transliteration: śīghram ākhyāta mām prāptam kauśikam gādhinaḥ sutam ।tat śrutvā vacanam tasya rājño veśma pradudruvuḥ ॥1-18-40॥

translations.english: Having reached the royal hall, they reported to the king (Dasaratha), descendant of the Ikshvakus about the arrival of sage Viswamitra.

verses.sloka: संभ्रान्त मनसः सर्वे तेन वाक्येन चोदिताः ।ते गत्वा राज भवनम् विश्वामित्रम् ऋषिम् तदा ॥१-१८-४१॥
verses.transliteration: saṁbhrānta manasaḥ sarve tena vākyena coditāḥ ।te gatvā rāja bhavanam viśvāmitram ṛṣim tadā ॥1-18-41॥

translations.english: Having heard their words, Dasaratha in great joy went forth together with his preceptors to receive him like Indra receiving Brahma.

verses.sloka: प्राप्तम् आवेदयामासुः नृपायैः इक्ष्वाकवे तदा ।तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा सपुरोधाः समाहितः ॥१-१८-४२॥
verses.transliteration: prāptam āvedayāmāsuḥ nṛpāyaiḥ ikṣvākave tadā ।teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā sapurodhāḥ samāhitaḥ ॥1-18-42॥

translations.english: Seeing Viswamitra, shining with the power of his penance fulfilled the king with a cheerful countenance made offerings with due respect.

verses.sloka: प्रति उज्जगाम संहृष्टो ब्रह्माणम् इव वासवः ।तम् दृष्ट्वा ज्वलितम् दीप्त्या तपसम् संशित व्रतम् ॥१-१८-४३॥
verses.transliteration: prati ujjagāma saṁhṛṣṭo brahmāṇam iva vāsavaḥ ।tam dṛṣṭvā jvalitam dīptyā tapasam saṁśita vratam ॥1-18-43॥

translations.english: Viswamitra received the offerings as ordained in the scriptures and enquired from the king about the welfare and prosperity of his kingdom.

verses.sloka: प्रहृष्ट वदनो राजा ततः अर्घ्यम् उपहारयत् ।स राज्ञः प्रतिगृह्य अर्घ्यम् शास्त्र दृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥१-१८-४४॥
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭa vadano rājā tataḥ arghyam upahārayat ।sa rājñaḥ pratigṛhya arghyam śāstra dṛṣṭena karmaṇā ॥1-18-44॥

translations.english: The exceedingly virtuous sage Viswamitra enquired from the king about the treasury welfare of his subjects living in cities and villages, and the well being of his friends and relatives.

verses.sloka: कुशलम् च अव्ययम् च एव पर्य पृच्छत् नराधिपम् ।पुरे कोशे जनपदे बान्धवेषु सुहृत्सु च ॥१-१८-४५॥
verses.transliteration: kuśalam ca avyayam ca eva parya pṛcchat narādhipam ।pure kośe janapade bāndhaveṣu suhṛtsu ca ॥1-18-45॥

translations.english: Are the tributary kings submissive to you? Have you conquered your enemies? Are the rites for propitiating gods and the services to humanity performed rightly?

verses.sloka: कुशलम् कौशिको राज्ञः पर्यपृच्छत् सुधार्मिकः ।अपि ते संनताः सर्वे सामंत रिपवो जिताः ॥१-१८-४६॥
verses.transliteration: kuśalam kauśiko rājñaḥ paryapṛcchat sudhārmikaḥ ।api te saṁnatāḥ sarve sāmaṁta ripavo jitāḥ ॥1-18-46॥

translations.english: The foremost of ascetis, Viswamitra approached Vasishta and all other distinguised sages following the protocal and enquired about their welfare.

verses.sloka: दैवम् च मानुषम् च एव कर्म ते साधु अनुष्टितम् ।वसिष्ठम् च समागम्य कुशलम् मुनिपुंगवः ॥१-१८-४७॥
verses.transliteration: daivam ca mānuṣam ca eva karma te sādhu anuṣṭitam ।vasiṣṭham ca samāgamya kuśalam munipuṁgavaḥ ॥1-18-47॥

translations.english: All of them with gladdened hearts entered the royal palace and sat down, in accordance with their position after having been duly honoured by the king.

verses.sloka: ऋषीम् च तान् यथा न्यायम् महाभाग उवाच ह ।ते सर्वे हृष्ट मनसः तस्य राज्ञो निवेशनम् ॥१-१८-४८॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīm ca tān yathā nyāyam mahābhāga uvāca ha ।te sarve hṛṣṭa manasaḥ tasya rājño niveśanam ॥1-18-48॥

translations.english: Then the munificent king, very much (at Viswamitra's arrival) pleased offered him a happy hospitality and spoke:

verses.sloka: विविशुः पूजिताः तेन निषेदुः च यथा अर्हतः ।अथ हृष्ट मना राजा विश्वामित्रम् महामुनिम् ॥१-१८-४९॥
verses.transliteration: viviśuḥ pūjitāḥ tena niṣeduḥ ca yathā arhataḥ ।atha hṛṣṭa manā rājā viśvāmitram mahāmunim ॥1-18-49॥

translations.english: "O great sage, welcome to you Your arrival, to me, is like nectar (to a human being), rains to the parched land, birth of a son to the childless through his worthy wife, recovery of lost properity and festive joy in a great achievemnt.

verses.sloka: उवाच परम उदारो हृष्टः तम् अभिपूजयन् ।यथा अमृतस्य संप्राप्तिः यथा वर्षम् अनूदके ॥१-१८-५०॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca parama udāro hṛṣṭaḥ tam abhipūjayan ।yathā amṛtasya saṁprāptiḥ yathā varṣam anūdake ॥1-18-50॥

translations.english: "O great sage, welcome to you Your arrival, to me, is like nectar (to a human being), rains to the parched land, birth of a son to the childless through his worthy wife, recovery of lost properity and festive joy in a great achievemnt.

verses.sloka: यथा सदृश दारेषु पुत्र जन्म अप्रजस्य वै ।प्रणष्टस्य यथा लाभो यथा हर्षो महोदये ॥१-१८-५१॥
verses.transliteration: yathā sadṛśa dāreṣu putra janma aprajasya vai ।praṇaṣṭasya yathā lābho yathā harṣo mahodaye ॥1-18-51॥

translations.english: "O Brahman! what is your desire and in what manner shall I fulfill it to your satisfaction? You are a role model for righteousness. How fortunate I am you have come! My birth is rendered fruitful. My life has accomplished its objective.

verses.sloka: तथा एव आगमनम् मन्ये स्वागतम् ते महामुने ।कम् च ते परमम् कामम् करोमि किमु हर्षितः ॥१-१८-५२॥
verses.transliteration: tathā eva āgamanam manye svāgatam te mahāmune ।kam ca te paramam kāmam karomi kimu harṣitaḥ ॥1-18-52॥

translations.english: "O Brahman! what is your desire and in what manner shall I fulfill it to your satisfaction? You are a role model for righteousness. How fortunate I am you have come! My birth is rendered fruitful. My life has accomplished its objective.

verses.sloka: पात्र भूतोऽसि मे ब्रह्मन् दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि मानद ।अद्य मे सफलम् जन्म जीवितम् च सु जीवितम् ॥१-१८-५३॥
verses.transliteration: pātra bhūto'si me brahman diṣṭyā prāpto'si mānada ।adya me saphalam janma jīvitam ca su jīvitam ॥1-18-53॥

translations.english: Earlier you were rajarshi, a warrior sage. By your austerities you have obtained the brilliance that lends radiance even to the Sun and the Moon you have gained the status of a brahmrshi. In several ways you are worthy of my worship.

verses.sloka: यस्माद् विप्रेन्द्रम् अद्राक्षम् सुप्रभाता निशा मम ।पूर्वम् राजर्षि शब्देन तपसा द्योतित प्रभः ॥१-१८-५४॥
verses.transliteration: yasmād viprendram adrākṣam suprabhātā niśā mama ।pūrvam rājarṣi śabdena tapasā dyotita prabhaḥ ॥1-18-54॥

translations.english: O Brahman your arrival has caused surprise to me. It has conferred great purity on me. O Lord by your very presence here, I feel I haved acquired the merits of a pilgrimage.

verses.sloka: ब्रह्मर्षित्वम् अनुप्राप्तः पूज्योअसि बहुधा मया ।तत् अद्भुतम् अभूत् विप्र पवित्रम् परमम् मम ॥१-१८-५५॥
verses.transliteration: brahmarṣitvam anuprāptaḥ pūjyoasi bahudhā mayā ।tat adbhutam abhūt vipra pavitram paramam mama ॥1-18-55॥

translations.english: Be pleased to tell me the purpose of your visit. I desire to be given the privilege of doing service to achieve your object.

verses.sloka: शुभ क्षेत्र गतः च अहम् तव संदर्शनात् प्रभो ।ब्रूहि यत् प्रार्थितम् तुभ्यम् कार्यम् आगमनम् प्रति ॥१-१८-५६॥
verses.transliteration: śubha kṣetra gataḥ ca aham tava saṁdarśanāt prabho ।brūhi yat prārthitam tubhyam kāryam āgamanam prati ॥1-18-56॥

translations.english: O Viswamitra you need not hesitatate to tell me what ought to be performed. I shall accomplish that act in every possible special way. You are a god to me.

verses.sloka: इच्छाम् अनुगृहीतो अहम् त्वदर्थम् परिवृद्धये ।कार्यस्य न विमर्शम् च गंतुम् अर्हसि सुव्रत ॥१-१८-५७॥
verses.transliteration: icchām anugṛhīto aham tvadartham parivṛddhaye ।kāryasya na vimarśam ca gaṁtum arhasi suvrata ॥1-18-57॥

translations.english: O Brahmin I have attained this high foutune today. My great merit has been realised as a result of your arrival".

verses.sloka: कर्ता च अहम् अशेषेण दैवतम् हि भवान् मम ।मम च अयम् अनुप्राप्तो महान् अभ्युदयो द्विज ।तव आगमन जः कृत्स्नो धर्मः च अनुत्तमो द्विज ॥१-१८-५८॥
verses.transliteration: kartā ca aham aśeṣeṇa daivatam hi bhavān mama ।mama ca ayam anuprāpto mahān abhyudayo dvija ।tava āgamana jaḥ kṛtsno dharmaḥ ca anuttamo dvija ॥1-18-58॥

translations.english: On hearing the words spoken in such an humble manner by the prudent king words pleasing to the mind and to the ears, the great rishi of celebrated virtues and fame, of sterling qualities experienced deep delight. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे अष्टादशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the eighteenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: इति हृदय सुखम् निशम्य वाक्यम्श्रुति सुखम् आत्मवता विनीतम् उक्तम् ।प्रथित गुण यशा गुणैः विशिष्टःपरम ऋषिः परमम् जगाम हर्षम् ॥१-१८-५९॥
verses.transliteration: iti hṛdaya sukham niśamya vākyamśruti sukham ātmavatā vinītam uktam ।prathita guṇa yaśā guṇaiḥ viśiṣṭaḥparama ṛṣiḥ paramam jagāma harṣam ॥1-18-59॥
